title: Lexical diversity, syntactic complexity, and readability: a corpus-based analysis of ChatGPT and L2 student essays

live_model.evidence: Methods: "The AI-generated texts were produced using OpenAI's GPT-4 Turbo, the version of GPT-4 provided to ChatGPT Plus subscribers via the web interface...All texts were generated in December 2024."

prompt.location: Methods (essay prompts identical to those assigned to students, each submitted 5 times)
prompt.note: Course-specific essay prompts, not fully quoted in the visible text.

claim.metric: linguistic complexity comparison, AI-generated vs. L2 student essays

data.source: Anonymized L2 student essays (United Arab Emirates university); AI essays newly generated for this study

notes: Generated via the ChatGPT Plus web interface rather than the API, so the exact snapshot cannot be pinned or reproduced through an API call; by December 2024 ChatGPT Plus's default model had already moved past GPT-4 Turbo, adding further doubt about the claimed version.
